description: Base de Datos de zonas sismogénicas de la Península Ibérica y territorios de influencia para el cálculo de la peligrosidad sísmica en España (ZESIS) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by info.igme.es. ZESIS is a database of seismogenic zones of the Iberian Peninsula and territories of influence developed for the calculation of the update of the seismic hazard map of Spain (IGN-UPM, 2013). Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Database of seismogenic zones of the Iberian Peninsula and territories of influence for the calculation of seismic hazar" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include EGDI. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
